title: Hayati Pro Max Rock Candy Orange Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Rocky Confectionary Orange captures the essence of a classic orange sweet with a bright, juicy flavour profile and a subtly sugary finish. The Orange comes through with a fresh citrus zing, rounded out by a mellow, confectionery-inspired backdrop that softens the sharpness without dulling the vibrancy. It's a playful nod to retro sweetshop favourites with a delightful citrus twist. This e-liquid is made with nicotine salts for rapid nicotine delivery and a smoother inhale, ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices like pod kits and vape pens. Its 50VG/50PG blend ensures satisfying flavour delivery with discreet vapour production. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
